capabilities: Publish a note to reMarkable as a PDF
Pull handwritten annotations back into the note
Transcribe page images with a vision LLM
Show page count and ask consent before paid transcription
Cache transcription results by PDF content hash
extras: Requires terminal setup of a Python CLI; publishing sends PDFs to reMarkable Cloud and pulling sends page images to OpenRouter; macOS, Linux and native Windows topologies are listed as untested; not yet on PyPI.
motivation: Built first for an AI agent workflow that pushes artifacts to e-ink, then pulls handwritten feedback back into the conversation.
problem: Handwritten annotations made on an e-ink tablet cannot be brought back into an Obsidian note as editable text.

relations.evidence: rmapi (a third-party Go binary downloaded from ddvk/rmapi releases, version-pinned and sha256-verified)
each page is rendered to a PNG image and sent to OpenRouter for vision transcription

summary: Bridge that publishes notes to a reMarkable tablet as PDFs and pulls handwritten annotations back into the note as text.
